name: – Tomáš Kubín – Commission proposal to the Council
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2020/262 as regards the general arrangements for excise duty in respect of tobacco and tobacco related products
part_text:
Parliament wants to update the rules on how much tobacco and nicotine people can bring across borders for their own use without paying extra tax. It adds new product types to the list: heated tobacco, e-cigarette liquid and nicotine pouches. The amounts allowed for these should be similar to those for products already on the list. Parliament also asks for the new product categories to be included in these limits.

- New limits added for heated tobacco, e-cigarette liquid and nicotine pouches brought across borders.
- Affects people who buy these products in one EU country and take them to another.
- Parliament's position goes to the Council of ministers, which decides.
